risks.title: Wall thickness 1.5 mm may be too thin for moldability/strength
risks.rationale: 1.5 mm ABS walls are near the lower bound for reliable fill and can warp; many guidelines recommend ~2.5-3 mm.
risks.mitigation: Increase nominal wall toward 2.5-3 mm or validate fill with mold-flow analysis.

risks.title: Thick boss (4.0 mm) risks sink marks
risks.rationale: Boss is >2x nominal wall; thick sections cool slower and cause sink/voids.
risks.mitigation: Core out the boss and keep features <=60% of nominal wall, add ribs.

risks.title: Sharp internal corner (R0) is a stress concentrator
risks.rationale: Zero-radius internal corners concentrate stress and impede flow.

risks.title: No draft angle specified
risks.rationale: Without draft, the part is hard to eject and may drag/scuff.
risks.mitigation: Specify >=1 deg draft on vertical faces.
